note: Rewritten from Sands' (1999) new species description, original in English; the genus lacks soldiers, only the worker has a complete description; measurements follow the original ranges.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Somewhat isolated in the ordination analysis, but closest to A. galenus and A. mbalmayoensis in the consensus tree. From A. mayombei it differs in that the latter has conspicuous stout setae on the fore coxa, the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible as long as that of the first marginal tooth, the fourth marginal tooth just touching the lateral edge of the molar prominence, the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible shorter than that of the second marginal tooth, the longest primary-row spines curved and not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three, and a bilaterally symmetrical valve. From A. mbalmayoensis it differs in that the latter is much larger, with distinctly longer legs, the proximal end of the fourth marginal tooth of the left mandible just touching or concealed behind the molar prominence, and the longest primary-row spines more numerous and shorter than the narrowest point of ridge three.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule, the darkest part of the antennal flagellum, pronotum and legs all pale yellow, abdominal tergites yellowish white. Head capsule circular or short-oval, nearly circular, setae sparse, projecting, the longest setae scattered at random. Fontanelle present as a pale spot or shallow depression. Anterior surface of the fore coxa without conspicuous stout setae; fore tibia with 3 distal spurs, the third reduced or far smaller than the other two. Left mandible: first marginal tooth nearly equilateral, anterior margin of the third marginal tooth shorter than that of the first marginal tooth, the proximal end of the fourth marginal tooth not touching the molar prominence in frontal view; right mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth as long as that of the second marginal tooth. Measurements: head width 0.657—0.713 mm; pronotum width 0.429—0.468 mm, length 0.206—0.293 mm; hind tibia length 0.665—0.692 mm; fore tibia length 0.525—0.549 mm; left mandible index 0.824—0.953, right mandible index 0.947—1.149.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The midgut–hindgut junction arises ventrally below the nerve cord; the first hindgut segment is rather short, up to 8 times as long as its proximal width, tubular throughout; in the undissected abdomen the enteric valve lies to the right of the heart (dorsal view) or to the left of the nerve cord (ventral view); the third lobe of the enteric valve seat is nearly as large as the outer pair. The enteric valve ridges are nearly taper-ellipsoid from the base towards the apical spines, or markedly waisted at the base and then widening, the ends of the ridges weakly sclerotized, pale yellow or yellow; the primary rows bear very long tapering spines, each ridge with at most 1—9, straight or curved but evenly tapering, longer than the narrowest width at the base of the apical spines of ridge three, the symmetry nearly three-radiate, the intercalary ridges reduced; the secondary rows bear conspicuous backward-directed spines on one or more ridges, lengthening towards the ridge apex.
